definitions.explanation: The ability or quality of producing original, creative ideas.

examples.japanese: {創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{創意|そうい}に{満|み}ちた{作品|さくひん}だ。
examples.english: It's a work full of originality.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}の{創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう}を{活|い}かして{新|あたら}しい{商品|しょうひん}を{開発|かいはつ}した。
examples.english: We developed a new product by leveraging employees' creative ideas.

notes:
Refers to the ability or act of coming up with original, creative ideas. A compound of {創|そう} (create) and {意|い} (idea/will). Most frequently used in the four-character compound {創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう} (originality and ingenuity).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう}: originality and ingenuity; creative problem-solving
- {創意|そうい}に{富|と}む: to be rich in originality
- {創意|そうい}に{満|み}ちた: full of originality
- {創意|そうい}を{発揮|はっき}する: to demonstrate creativity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独創|どくそう}: unique creativity — emphasizes being one-of-a-kind
- {工夫|くふう}: ingenuity; devising — focuses on practical problem-solving
- {創造力|そうぞうりょく}: creative power; imagination
